_doc: Converted CE maps tools/level/upgrade_ce_map.py takes through the B30 pipeline. conversion: the map's convert_ce_map.sh output (level file, sbsp, staging/placement.json); scene: the folder whose scene.gltf and materials.spec.json the landscape and foliage are baked from (the conversion when omitted); shaders: the ground shaders' name substrings (build_landscape --shader); landscape: the editor world's code (/Game/Levels/Halo1/Solo/<code>/<code>) and chunk; details: protected detail bitmaps by class (scatter_foliage --detail); water: parameters for the level's ocean; tints: foliage rule tints (scatter_foliage --rule-tint); rocks: beach (B30's Uluwatu, the default) or desert boulders for swapped CE rocks; base_level: the level file to build on when it is not the conversion's own (the separate water mesh and ocean settings of 2026-10-11 live only in the installed files, snapshotted); environment: merged into the level's environment (skylight.lower: the ground's bounce colour; clouds: volumetric clouds); mesh_container: a mesh container (.utoc/.ucas stem) to install over the hub copy's (the separate water mesh of 2026-10-11); hub: the hub slug the install replaces; components: landscape components a side when the default does not suit.
